title: Je grandis chaque jour
oneGoal: Students understand that growing and changing is natural and positive
decisionPoints: How comfortable are students sharing personal growth experiences?
What visual supports are needed for growth vocabulary?
How can we make growth tangible for young learners?
progression: Foundation lesson introducing the unit's central concepts of growth and change
realWorldConnection: Students recognize daily changes in themselves (height, skills, knowledge)

title: Mes changements spéciaux
oneGoal: Students identify personal changes they've experienced and feel proud of them
decisionPoints: Which students need encouragement to share achievements?
How can we celebrate different types of growth?
What scaffolding is needed for comparison vocabulary?
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by making growth personal and specific to each child
realWorldConnection: Children recognize their own achievements (walking, talking, reading first words)

title: Célébrer nos familles
oneGoal: Students appreciate how families celebrate milestones and traditions together
decisionPoints: How can we include diverse family structures?
What visual supports help explain family celebrations?
How can quiet students share family traditions?
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by extending personal growth to family context and celebrations
realWorldConnection: Students connect to birthdays, holidays, and special family moments

title: Mes souvenirs de bébé
oneGoal: Students compare their baby selves to now, recognizing tremendous growth
decisionPoints: How can students without baby photos participate fully?
What support is needed for time comparison vocabulary?
How can we make the growth concept concrete?
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by focusing on individual growth timeline from birth to present
realWorldConnection: Students see baby photos and understand their incredible development journey

title: Mes amis changent aussi
oneGoal: Students recognize that their friends are also growing and changing
decisionPoints: How can students practice noticing positive changes in peers?
What support is needed for observation vocabulary?
How can we encourage kind observations?
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by expanding growth awareness from self to peer relationships
realWorldConnection: Students notice friends' new skills, interests, and physical growth

title: Mes rêves pour grandir
oneGoal: Students express hopes and dreams for their future growth
decisionPoints: How can students visualize future goals appropriately?
What support is needed for future tense concepts?
How can we make dreams feel achievable?
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by projecting growth concepts into the future
realWorldConnection: Students think about what they want to learn or become

title: Nos traditions de classe
oneGoal: Students create and appreciate classroom traditions that bring the community together
decisionPoints: Which classroom traditions resonate most with students?
How can all students contribute to tradition-making?
What visual supports help explain community concepts?
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by creating shared growth experiences within the classroom community
realWorldConnection: Students participate in daily routines and special class celebrations

title: Capsule temporelle
oneGoal: Students create a time capsule documenting their current selves for future reflection
decisionPoints: What items best represent each student's current interests?
How can students understand the time capsule concept?
What support is needed for reflection vocabulary?
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by creating a concrete artifact for measuring future growth
realWorldConnection: Students preserve current memories and interests to revisit later

title: Histoires de famille
oneGoal: Students share and listen to meaningful family stories about growth and milestones
decisionPoints: How can students with language barriers participate?
What scaffolding supports story-telling skills?
How can we honor diverse family experiences?
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by connecting personal growth to family narratives and oral tradition
realWorldConnection: Students learn about family history and meaningful family moments

title: Mes moments de fierté
oneGoal: Students identify and celebrate moments when they felt proud of their growth
decisionPoints: How can students recognize different types of success?
What support is needed for emotion vocabulary?
How can quiet students share pride moments?
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by helping students recognize and value their personal achievements
realWorldConnection: Students connect to learning to ride bikes, helping others, solving problems

title: Grandir ensemble à l'école
oneGoal: Students understand how the school community supports everyone's growth
decisionPoints: How can students recognize various forms of school support?
What examples resonate with their school experience?
How can we make community support visible?
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by extending individual pride to community support systems
realWorldConnection: Students recognize teachers, principals, and peers who help them grow

title: Célébrer nos apprentissages
oneGoal: Students recognize and celebrate the learning growth they've made this year
decisionPoints: What learning milestones are most meaningful to celebrate?
How can students self-assess their progress?
What supports are needed for academic vocabulary?
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by focusing specifically on academic and skill-based growth
realWorldConnection: Students see improvement in reading, math, social skills, and independence

title: Portfolio de croissance
oneGoal: Students compile evidence of their growth throughout the year in a personal portfolio
decisionPoints: Which artifacts best demonstrate each student's growth?
How can students organize their learning evidence?
What reflection supports are needed for portfolio creation?
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by creating a comprehensive record of learning and personal growth
realWorldConnection: Students create a keepsake showing their journey from beginning to end of year

title: Présentation de croissance
oneGoal: Students present their growth journey to others, demonstrating confidence in their development
decisionPoints: What presentation format works best for each student?
How can nervous speakers be supported?
What audience is most encouraging for presentations?
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by having students share and celebrate their complete growth story
realWorldConnection: Students practice public speaking while celebrating personal achievements

title: Jeu de mémoire de croissance
oneGoal: Students reinforce growth vocabulary and concepts through engaging games
decisionPoints: Which game format maintains engagement for all learners?
How can different ability levels participate successfully?
What adaptations support diverse learning needs?
progression: Extension activity building on all previous lessons through interactive vocabulary practice
realWorldConnection: Students play games that reinforce learning in fun, social contexts

title: Art de croissance créatif
oneGoal: Students express their growth journey through creative art projects
decisionPoints: What art materials best support creative expression?
How can students with different artistic abilities succeed?
What connections can be made between art and growth?
progression: Extension activity building on portfolio concept through artistic expression of growth
realWorldConnection: Students use art to communicate feelings and experiences about growing up

title: Théâtre de traditions familiales
oneGoal: Students act out family traditions, deepening understanding of cultural celebrations
decisionPoints: How can shy students participate comfortably in drama?
What support is needed for dramatic expression?
How can diverse traditions be represented respectfully?
progression: Extension activity building on Lesson 3 and 9 through dramatic exploration of family traditions
realWorldConnection: Students embody family celebrations and share cultural practices

title: Livre de classe collectif
oneGoal: Students collaborate to create a class book celebrating everyone's growth stories
decisionPoints: How can all students contribute meaningfully to the book?
What format allows for diverse contribution styles?
How can collaboration be structured for success?
progression: Extension activity combining elements from multiple lessons into a collaborative celebration
realWorldConnection: Students create a lasting record of their shared classroom community growth

title: Fête de croissance
oneGoal: Students celebrate their growth journey with a culminating community celebration
decisionPoints: What celebration elements are most meaningful to students?
How can families be included in the celebration?
What roles allow all students to participate confidently?
progression: Extension activity bringing together all unit concepts in a joyful community celebration
realWorldConnection: Students experience the joy of shared celebration and community recognition

title: Réflexion sur notre voyage
oneGoal: Students reflect on their complete learning journey and look forward to continued growth
decisionPoints: What reflection tools help students process their learning?
How can students express their future growth goals?
What supports help students recognize their transformation?
progression: Final extension activity helping students synthesize all learning and project forward
realWorldConnection: Students understand that growth is ongoing and look forward to summer and Grade 2
